ExternalSiteEvidence._comment: SSL Labs / Qualys TLS evidence is enabled by default for HIP MVP testing. Set ExternalProvidersEnabled=false or SslLabs.Enabled=false to disable outbound TLS checks.

HipSecurity._privacyHashingRotationComment: Supply PrivacyHashingKey and LegacyPrivacyHashingKeys through a secret provider. Keep at most eight legacy keys only until dependent owner partitions are retired; never commit them here.

HipAuthentication._comment: Production values are required from deployment configuration. Supply ClientSecret through a secret provider; never commit it here.

HipSessionProtection._comment: Production values must reference a shared key-ring directory and a secret-mounted PKCS#12 certificate. Supply CertificatePassword through a secret provider.
